item.title: Melania Trump’s Inaugural Gown Added to Smithsonian Collection, Highlighting Her Signature Style
item.description: Melania Trump’s inaugural gown is now part of the Smithsonian National Museum of American History’s First Ladies Collection, marking another milestone in the tradition of preserving the fashion of America’s presidential spouses.The gown, worn during her husband’s second inauguration, was designed by longtime stylist and designer Herve Pierre. item.title: Palm Springs Businesses Feel Impact as Canadian Snowbirds Appear to Decline During Peak Season
item.description: Peak season in the Coachella Valley typically brings a surge of visitors — especially Canadian snowbirds — but many Palm Springs business owners say this year feels different.Across the city, retailers and note fewer Canadian customers shopping and dining compared to past winters. item.description: A one-of-a-kind event is happening tonight in Palm Springs, giving guests rare access to one of the city’s most iconic homes — all while supporting a meaningful local cause.For the first time ever, the Shag House is hosting a special fundraiser to benefit the Palm Springs Animal Shelter. item.description: A new era of local advertising is rolling into the desert with the launch of BrightPath Billboards, a locally owned mobile LED billboard truck company founded by Marcus Tillman.Unlike traditional billboards that stay fixed in one location, the company’s digital billboard trucks travel throughout the Coachella Valley, delivering advertising messages directly to neighborhoods, high-traffic corridors, and community events. item.title: Road Improvement Project to Begin in Rancho Mirage
item.description: A road improvement project designed to reduce blowing sand and improve traffic safety is set to begin Monday in Rancho Mirage.The project includes road widening and fence installation along Ramon Road between Los Alamos Road and Bob Hope Drive. item.title: Illinois Governor JB Pritzker Demands $8.6 Billion Tariff Refund After Supreme Court Ruling
